title: Interlock Logic & Cause Effect Matrix - KC-4501 (SEQ-4501)
content:
INTERLOCK LOGIC & CAUSE EFFECT MATRIX: SEQ-4501 (RECYCLE GAS COMPRESSOR (KC-4501) SHUTDOWN LOGIC).
Document No: TJC-LLD-IL-KC-4501, Revision: Rev 3, SIL Level: SIL 2.
Equipment: KC-4501, Functional Location: TJC-LLD-4500-01.
CAUSE & EFFECT MATRIX (TRIPS):
- T1: Lube oil pressure LOW-LOW (PSLL-4504 < 1.5 barg, 2oo3) -> Actions: Trip (EFF-1), Open (EFF-2), Close (EFF-3), Annunciate (EFF-5)
- T2: Discharge temperature HIGH-HIGH (TSHH-4503 > 140 degC, 1oo1) -> Actions: Trip (EFF-1), Open (EFF-2), Annunciate (EFF-5)
- T3: Discharge pressure HIGH-HIGH (PSHH-4502 > 14 barg, 1oo2) -> Actions: Trip (EFF-1), Open (EFF-2), Annunciate (EFF-5)
- T4: Crosshead vibration HIGH-HIGH (VSHH-4505 > 11 mm/s, 1oo2) -> Actions: Trip (EFF-1), Open (EFF-2), Close (EFF-3), Annunciate (EFF-5)
- T5: Suction KO drum level HIGH-HIGH (LSHH-4510 > 80 %, 1oo1) -> Actions: Trip (EFF-1), Close (EFF-3), Annunciate (EFF-5)
- T6: Suction pressure LOW-LOW (PSLL-4501 < 0.3 barg, 1oo1) -> Actions: Trip (EFF-1), Open (EFF-2), Annunciate (EFF-5)
START PERMISSIVES (AND-gate conditions to start pump):
- P1: Lube oil pressure OK (> 2 barg) (PSLL-4504, Gate Logic: AND)
- P2: Seal gas established (FT-4506, Gate Logic: AND)
- P3: KO drum level normal (< 50%) (LT-4510, Gate Logic: AND)
- P4: Jacket water flow OK (FSL-4508, Gate Logic: AND)
- P5: No active trip / reset done (DCS reset, Gate Logic: AND)
- —: ALL permissives TRUE → START KC-4501 ENABLED (—, Gate Logic: AND)
CROSS REFERENCES: P&ID: TJC-LLD-PID-4501, Datasheet: TJC-LLD-DS-KC-4501.
